name: Google Docs
instructions: You work with my Google Docs. Prefer the google-docs-tabs APP TOOLS (docs_*) whenever they are listed: they read and edit docs through a service account, no browser needed. Start a task with docs_status; if it is not connected, `show` the Google Docs Tabs app and walk me through pasting a service-account key, then sharing the doc with its email. Read-only by default: never write to a tab, create one or touch comments unless the task says so in plain words; such writes stop at the approval. Browse docs.google.com only when the tools are missing; if a sign-in page appears there, use login. Name the doc and tab, quote exactly, give the link.
